---
title: "Calculate Arctic NPP"
author: "Patrick Pata"
date: "2026-05-27"
output: html_document
---

Calculate annual NPP of the Arctic from the Takuvik NPP model. Resolution: 4 km.
Outputs: https://zenodo.org/records/20028548
Code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14715624

Model citation: Takuvik, & UQAR. (2025). Arctic Ocean Net Primary Production Model Code (v1.0). Takuvik. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14715624

Grid file: CCI-V6_NPP_1D_DAILY_4KM_SIN_TAKUVIK_ARCTIC_ALLPIXELS_COORDINATES.csv ... where is this file?


Daily NPP is summed to get annual NPP. To deal with NAs, interpolate between points with existing data 

NPP unit is (mgC.m-2.d-1)  
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


# Load the Takuvik NPP model output data
```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# Loop through all files and retain daily NPP in mgC m-2 d-1
years <- 2014:2023

all_years_npp <- lapply(years, function(year) {
  fol <- paste0("C:/Sync/Arctic NPP model results/",
                "CCI-V6_NPP_1D_DAILY_4KM_SIN_TAKUVIK_ARCTIC_", year, "_ppv2/" )
  
  # Get filenames in a folder (# days with data can differ)
  csv_files <- list.files(fol, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  # Extract daily data
  daily_npp <- lapply(seq_along(csv_files), function(i) {
    read.csv(csv_files[i]) %>%
      filter(longitude >= -94 & longitude <= -52 &
               latitude >= 55 & latitude <= 83) %>% 
      mutate(filename = basename(csv_files[i]),
             DOY = i, year = year,
             date = as.Date(stringr::str_extract(filename, "\\d{8}"),
                            format = "%Y%m%d"))}) %>%
    bind_rows()
  
  print(paste0("Finished processing: ", year))
  
  return(daily_npp) }) %>%
  bind_rows()

save(all_years_npp, 
     file = "data/subset_TakuvikNPP_2014_2023.RData")

# load("data/subset_TakuvikNPP_2019_2023.RData")
```

## Match grid data with UVP6 profile locations and regions
```{r}
# Get nearest neighbor grid cells relative to the Amundsen UVP data
library(geosphere)

load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20260321.RData") # contains Amund_UVP6_meta

df_target <- all_years_npp %>% 
  select(binindex, lon = longitude, lat = latitude) %>% 
  distinct(binindex, lon, lat)

df_source <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  select(region.inuk, lon = object_lon, lat = object_lat) %>% 
  distinct(lon, lat, .keep_all = T)

# within # km from UVP6 point
dist_matrix <- distm(
  x = df_target[, c("lon", "lat")],
  y = df_source[, c("lon", "lat")],
  fun = distHaversine
)

nearest_within_20km <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_target)), function(i) {
  idx <- which(dist_matrix[i, ] <= 20000)

  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)

  df_source[idx, ] %>%
    mutate(
      target_id = i,
      target_binindex = df_target$binindex[i],
      target_lon = df_target$lon[i],
      target_lat = df_target$lat[i],
      distance_m = dist_matrix[i, idx]
    ) }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# check if there are any overlaps between regions
check.overlap <- nearest_within_20km %>% 
  distinct(region.inuk, target_binindex, target_lon, target_lat) %>% 
  group_by(target_binindex) %>% 
  mutate(nreg = n()) %>% 
  filter(nreg > 1)
```

# Average regional NPP
1. Average all cells in a region 
2. Interpolate daily blanks in a region
3. Sum NPP in each region
```{r}
region_daily_npp <- all_years_npp %>% 
  filter(binindex %in% nearest_within_20km$target_binindex) %>% 
  # QA/QC
  filter(!is.na(NPP)) %>% 
  filter(NPP <= quantile(all_years_npp$NPP, 0.99)) %>% # exclude anomalously high values 
  group_by(binindex, year, latitude, longitude) %>%
  mutate(ndays = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # Add subregion information
  left_join(nearest_within_20km %>% 
              rename(longitude = target_lon, latitude = target_lat) %>% 
              distinct(region.inuk, longitude, latitude),
            by = join_by(longitude, latitude)) %>% 
  # Get region average  NPP per DOY
  group_by(region.inuk, date, year, DOY) %>%
  summarise(ncells = n(),
            NPP_mean = mean(NPP),
            NPP_sd = sd(NPP),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(NPP_mean > 0)

ggplot(region_daily_npp, aes(x = DOY, y = NPP_mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = year), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuk)


ggplot(region_daily_npp %>% 
         filter(region.inuk == "Nares Strait"), 
       aes(x = DOY, y = NPP_mean)) +
  # geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = region.inuk)) +
  geom_smooth() +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~year)



# TODO actually do the DOY difference thing here
region_daily_npp_interp <- region_daily_npp %>%
  group_by(year, region.inuk) %>%
  mutate(ndays_orig = n()) %>%
  mutate(DOY_with_value = DOY) %>%
  complete(DOY = 1:365) %>%
  arrange(DOY, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  # Calculate gap between points with value
  mutate(prev_DOY = DOY_with_value,
         next_DOY = DOY_with_value) %>% 
  fill(prev_DOY, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(next_DOY, .direction = "up") %>%
  mutate(DOY_gap = next_DOY - prev_DOY,
         DOY_to_next = next_DOY - DOY) %>%
  filter(DOY_gap <= 30) %>% # do not interpolate beyond a month
  mutate(NPP_interp = approx(
      x = DOY[!is.na(NPP_mean)],
      y = NPP_mean[!is.na(NPP_mean)],
      xout = DOY,
      rule = 1 )$y) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(NPP_interp))


# Calculate the annual NPP per subregion
region_annual_npp_interp <- region_daily_npp_interp %>%
  group_by(year, region.inuk) %>%
  summarise(ndays = n(),
            mean_cells = mean(ncells, na.rm = T),
            NPP_mgCm2yr = sum(NPP_interp, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(NPP_gCm2yr = NPP_mgCm2yr / 1000) %>%
  filter(NPP_gCm2yr > 0)

region_clim_npp <- region_annual_npp_interp %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(nyears = n(),
            NPP_mean = mean(NPP_gCm2yr),
            NPP_sd = sd(NPP_gCm2yr),
            days_mean = mean(ndays),
            days_sd = sd(ndays),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(region_annual_npp_interp,
       aes(x = year, y = NPP_gCm2yr)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuk)

ggplot(region_clim_npp,
       aes(x = region.inuk, y = NPP_mean)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = NPP_mean - NPP_sd,
                    ymax = NPP_mean + NPP_sd)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_bw()



NPP.table <- region_clim_npp %>% 
  # Add values from flux.comp.200
  left_join(flux.comp.200 %>%
              left_join(region_rename %>% 
                          select(reg.inuk, region.inuk), by = "reg.inuk") %>% 
              select(region.inuk,
                     LPC_flux = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean,
                     POC_flux = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean)) %>% 
  mutate(sumC_flux = LPC_flux + POC_flux) %>% 
  # ratios
  mutate(LPC_NPP = LPC_flux/NPP_mean,
         POC_NPP = POC_flux/NPP_mean,
         LPCPOC_NPP = sumC_flux/NPP_mean)


# write.csv(NPP.table, file = "tables/NPP_ratio_20260528.csv")
```

```{r}

  geom_point(aes(color = region.inuk)) +
```

# --- cell-by-cell averaging & interpolation ---
# Only analyze grid cells matching UVP6 profiles
```{r, warning=FALSE}
daily_npp_sub <- all_years_npp %>% 
  filter(binindex %in% nearest_within_20km$target_binindex) %>% 
  # QA/QC
  filter(!is.na(NPP)) %>% 
  filter(NPP <= quantile(all_years_npp$NPP, 0.99), # exclude anomalously high values
         NPP >= quantile(all_years_npp$NPP, 0.01)) %>% 
  group_by(binindex, year, latitude, longitude) %>%
  mutate(ndays = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # only grid cells with >= 3 data points (days)
  filter(ndays >= 3) %>% 
  # Add subregion information
  left_join(nearest_within_20km %>% 
              rename(longitude = target_lon, latitude = target_lat) %>% 
              distinct(region.inuk, longitude, latitude),
            by = join_by(longitude, latitude)) 

ncells_per_region <- daily_npp_sub %>% 
  distinct(region.inuk, year, binindex) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk, year) %>% 
  count()

daily_npp_interp <- daily_npp_sub %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk, binindex, year, latitude, longitude) %>%
  mutate(DOY_with_value = DOY) %>%
  complete(DOY = 1:365) %>%
  arrange(DOY, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  # Calculate gap between points with value
  mutate(prev_DOY = DOY_with_value,
         next_DOY = DOY_with_value) %>% 
  fill(prev_DOY, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(next_DOY, .direction = "up") %>%
  mutate(DOY_gap = next_DOY - prev_DOY,
         DOY_to_next = next_DOY - DOY) %>%
  filter(DOY_gap <= 7) %>%  # Only interpolate for 7 days difference
  mutate(NPP_interp = approx(
      x = DOY[!is.na(NPP)],
      y = NPP[!is.na(NPP)],
      xout = DOY,
      rule = 1 )$y) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(NPP_interp))


annual_npp_interp <- daily_npp_interp %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk, binindex, year, longitude, latitude) %>% 
  summarise(ndays = n(),
            NPP_mgCm2yr = sum(NPP_interp, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(NPP_gCm2yr = NPP_mgCm2yr / 1000)

# get regional averages
annual_npp_region <- annual_npp_interp %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk, year) %>% 
  summarise(ncells = n(),
            ndays_mean = mean(ndays),
            ndays_sd = sd(ndays),
            NPP_gCm2yr_mean = mean(NPP_gCm2yr),
            NPP_gCm2yr_sd = sd(NPP_gCm2yr),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(NPP_gCm2yr_se = NPP_gCm2yr_sd/sqrt(ncells))

# get 10-year average
clim_annual_npp_region <- annual_npp_region %>% 
  group_by(region.inuk) %>% 
  summarise(ndays_mean_mean = mean(ndays_mean),
            ndays_mean_sd = sd(ndays_mean),
            NPP_gCm2yr_mean_mean = mean(NPP_gCm2yr_mean),
            NPP_gCm2yr_mean_sd = sd(NPP_gCm2yr_mean),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(NPP_gCm2yr_mean_se = NPP_gCm2yr_mean_sd/sqrt(5))

# spatial distribution of a single year
ggplot(annual_npp_interp %>% 
         filter(year == 2023), 
       aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, 
           color = NPP_gCm2yr)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(limits = c(0,60), oob = scales::squish)


# average annual NPP for 10 years
ggplot(clim_annual_npp_region,
       aes(x = region.inuk, y = NPP_gCm2yr_mean_mean)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = NPP_gCm2yr_mean_mean - NPP_gCm2yr_mean_se,
                    ymax = NPP_gCm2yr_mean_mean + NPP_gCm2yr_mean_se)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_bw()
```

# Summary table of NPP
```{r}
# What is the ratio of the LPC & POC flux accounting for NPP?
load("data/UVP6_POC_lipidC_flux_comparisons_20260515.RData")

NPP.table <- annual_npp_region %>% 
  filter(year == 2023) %>% 
  select(region.inuk, ndays_2023 = ndays_mean, 
         NPP_2023 = NPP_gCm2yr_mean,
         NPP_2023_se = NPP_gCm2yr_se) %>% 
  left_join(clim_annual_npp_region %>% 
              select(region.inuk,
                     ndays_clim = ndays_mean_mean,  
                     ndays_clim_sd = ndays_mean_sd,
                     NPP_clim = NPP_gCm2yr_mean_mean,
                     NPP_clim_sd = NPP_gCm2yr_mean_sd,
                     NPP_clim_se = NPP_gCm2yr_mean_se)) %>% 
  
  # TODO add values from flux.comp.200
  left_join(flux.comp.200 %>%
              left_join(region_rename %>% 
                          select(reg.inuk, region.inuk), by = "reg.inuk") %>% 
              select(region.inuk,
                     LPC_flux = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean,
                     POC_flux = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean)) %>% 
  mutate(sumC_flux = LPC_flux + POC_flux) %>% 
  # ratios
  mutate(LPC_NPP = LPC_flux/NPP_clim,
         POC_NPP = POC_flux/NPP_clim,
         LPCPOC_NPP = sumC_flux/NPP_clim)

# Plot relative ratio to NPP by subregion
clrs <- c("firebrick","#FF6800","#FFB300","forestgreen", "blue1","purple2","#F6768E")

ggplot(NPP.table, aes(x = NPP_clim)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = LPC_NPP, color = region.inuk), shape = 16, size = 2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = POC_NPP, color = region.inuk), shape = 4, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
  xlab("Annual NPP") +
  ylab("LPC:NPP or POC:NPP") + 
  theme_bw()

NPP.long <- NPP.table %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(LPC_NPP, POC_NPP),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot(NPP.long, aes(x = NPP_clim, y = value)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = region.inuk, alpha = type),
           stat = "identity") +
  geom_point(data = NPP.table, 
             aes(y = LPC_NPP), color = "black", shape = 18, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.5, 1)) +
  xlab("Annual NPP") +
  ylab("C flux:NPP") +
  theme_bw()

```
